trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the 2-sentence remark. No negation-contrast, pivot, dash, triple, aphorism, meta-commentary, thesis restatement, warmth, superlative, or non-speakable chain.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: MATH FLAG (not a trap, reported not fixed): the stated reason is wrong. 'The non-degeneracy of the Frobenius form forces H^0(M, Ad(A)) = 0, as any global parallel section in the adjoint representation would pair with itself against the irreducibility constraint.' A non-zero invariant section pairing non-trivially with itself is not a contradiction - non-degeneracy does not force the vanishing. The corpus's own proof of this fact (prf:fiber-adjoint-involution) derives it from SU(2) emergence plus SCHUR'S LEMMA on the 3-dimensional irreducible adjoint representation. This is the same mis-attribution to int_A / non-degeneracy that closes prf:fiber-adjoint-involution, so it is a repeated pattern rather than a one-off. PROPOSED: 'Because Ad(A) is the irreducible adjoint representation of the reconstructed gauge group, Schur's lemma gives H^0(M, Ad(A)) = 0.' SECOND FLAG: this block writes H^0(M, Ad(A)) while rem:fibre-functor-rigidity in the same chapter writes H^0_G(Ad(A)) for what reads as the same object; one notation should be chosen.
